q: What It Takes to Make the Stay

r: Develop and execute marketing strategies: Lead branding, messaging, and multi-channel marketing plans aligned with hotel goals, adjusting tactics based on market trends and performance data

q: Strong hands-on experience with Oracle MDM.

Support data migration, data cleansing, and master data synchronization initiatives.
Provide technical leadership and best practices for Oracle MDM implementations and enhancements.

All blend gracefully into their surroundings and offer luxurious accommodation, superb cuisine and unrivalled facilities - complemented by impeccable service.
For leisure and business guests alike, the name Kempinski has long been synonymous with style, mobility and efficiency. Put simply, they are the first choice for the discerning individual.
